body:
Adds `research/chip-rtl-loop`: a four-stage checker (Verilator lint, Icarus lockstep simulation, Yosys SAT proof for combinational tasks) on nine small tasks. The session is the proposer. 6/9 pass at round 0 and 9/9 after one feedback round. This is anecdotal and not an LLM benchmark; the README says so.

Includes 4 tests, a README bullet and a site entry. `python site/build.py` prints ok. The run log line is the last commit.
